title: Editor crashes upon opening project created in Dev 4 with Godot 4.8 Dev 5
body:
### Tested versions

**Reproducible in:** Godot 4.8 dev 5
**Not Reproducible in:** Godot 4.8 dev 4

### System information

MacOS Golden Gate

### Issue description

I created a project in Godot 4.8 dev 4, no issues at all. When trying to open the same project in dev 5 crashes Godot every single time.

### Steps to reproduce

1 - Create project in Godot 4.8 dev 4
2 - Open the same project in Godot 4.8 dev 5

Godot then crashes each time.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

NA.
